Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: contrasting side length. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette marigold-green. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
